name: Rugs and Rug Pads That Don't Damage Your Finish
title-tag: Rug Pads That Won't Damage Hardwood Floor Finish
meta-description: Which rug pads are safe on hardwood, which ones bond to the finish, and how long to wait after refinishing before rugs go down. From a WA refinishing crew.
post-summary: December 9, 2026 · Felt and felt-plus-natural-rubber pads are safe; PVC waffle pads and rubber-backed mats slowly bond to polyurethane and print patterns into it. The 7-day rug rule after refinishing, the sun-line problem, and what fixes the damage once it's done.
